name: flywheel-writing-workspace
description: Portable Flywheel Writing Workspace MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare and commit owner-local writing receipts over MCP.
interface.longDescription: A stateful MCP companion for Flywheel Writing Workspace. It prepares proposal-backed writing mutations and can commit an already approved grant. The server cannot approve its own proposals; set FLYWHEEL_HOME to bind an operator-owned state directory before use. Per-call home arguments cannot redirect that bound state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Prepare this Writing Workspace change as a Flywheel proposal; do not approve it through MCP.
